$comment: GENERATED by scripts/build-catalog.mjs from Liquid schemas and docs. Do not edit; run `npm run build:catalog`.

settings.label: Logo on dark / transparent header
settings.info: Light version shown when the header sits over a hero image.

settings.label: Mobile logo
settings.info: Optional. Falls back to the main logo.

settings.label: Logo maximum height
settings.info: Keeps tall logos from pushing the header icons.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Square image, at least 180 × 180 px.

settings.label: Drawers and menus color scheme
settings.info: Cart drawer, mobile menu, filters and search.

settings.label: Custom font file (optional)
settings.info: Upload a .woff2 in Content → Files and paste its file name. Overrides the font above.

settings.label: Letter spacing
settings.info: In thousandths of the font size (-75 to 250).

settings.label: Custom font file (optional)
settings.info: Upload a .woff2 in Content → Files and paste its file name. Overrides the font above.

settings.label: Icon line width
settings.info: 10 = thin, 25 = bold.

settings.label: Section spacing
settings.info: Scales the top and bottom padding of every section.

settings.label: Cut corner
settings.info: Cuts the top-right corner diagonally for a technical look. 0 = off.

settings.label: Image fit
settings.info: "Fit" keeps cut-out product photos whole; "Fill" crops lifestyle photos to the shape.

settings.label: Show rating
settings.info: Needs a reviews app that fills the standard rating metafields.

settings.label: Title lines
settings.info: 0 = show the full title.

settings.label: Swatch style
settings.info: Variant pictures use each colour's variant image; colours without one show a colour chip.

settings.label: Show a sale countdown on cards
settings.info: Only for products whose date metafield holds a future end date (type "Date and time"). Nothing is shown without a real date.

settings.label: "New" badge for products published within (days)
settings.info: 0 = off. Uses each product's publish date.

settings.label: Colour option names
settings.info: Options with these names show colour chips (separate names with commas). Options whose values have swatches in Shopify admin always do.

settings.label: Color names
settings.info: One per line: "Name: #hex", "Name: file-name.jpg" (a picture uploaded in Content → Files) or "Name: https://…" (full image link). Swatches set in Shopify admin take priority.

settings.label: Enlarged picture on hover
settings.info: Picture swatches show a larger version with the value's name when hovered or focused.

settings.label: Reveal sections on scroll
settings.info: Always off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Fade in images as they load
Page transitions
settings.info: Cross-fades between pages in supporting browsers. No extra script.

settings.label: Show currency codes
settings.info: E.g. $14.61 USD. Useful when selling in several currencies.

settings.label: Free shipping thresholds
settings.info: One amount per currency, e.g. "USD:50, EUR:45". A plain number applies to your store currency. Leave blank to hide the progress bar. The free shipping rate itself is set in Settings → Shipping.

settings.label: Show order note in cart drawer
Require agreement to terms before checkout
settings.info: Adds a checkbox to the cart drawer and cart page. Accelerated checkout buttons are hidden on the cart page while this is on.

settings.label: Show recommendations in cart drawer
settings.info: Based on the first product in the cart.

settings.label: Collections to show
settings.info: Shown as tiles when the cart drawer is empty.

settings.label: Placeholder text
settings.info: Leave blank for the default "Search products…".

settings.label: Suggested links
settings.info: Menu shown before the shopper types. Items with sub-links become groups.

settings.label: Show results while typing
settings.info: Products, collections, pages, articles and query suggestions.

settings.label: Preload pages on hover
settings.info: Browsers fetch the next page while the pointer rests on a link. Skips cart, checkout and account.

entries.name: Age verification
entries.description: Age gate shown before the store can be used: heading, text, optional image, "confirm" and "leave" buttons. Only an explicit confirm is remembered (for N days); Escape, clicks outside and the browser cannot dismiss it. "Leave" goes to the link you set, or explains that the store cannot be used. Blocks page scroll, keeps keyboard focus inside and sits above everything else. In the theme editor it opens while the section is selected and can be closed there.
entries.use_when: the "Overlays" section group only, for stores that legally require visitors to confirm their age.

settings.label: Test mode
settings.info: Shows on every page load, ignoring earlier confirmations. Turn off before going live.

settings.label: Ask again after
settings.info: Days after a visitor confirms. Only an explicit confirmation is remembered.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: You must be of legal age in your country to view this store. Are you of legal age?

settings.label: Leave button link
settings.info: Where visitors go when they are not of age. Leave empty to show a message instead.

settings.label: Message after "Leave"
settings.default: Sorry, you must be of legal age to view this store.

entries.name: Anchor navigation
entries.description: Sticky in-page navigation ("scroll spy"): a rounded pill bar that stays just below the header (or the top of the screen when the header is hidden) with an optional back-to-top button and one link per target section. Clicking a link scrolls smoothly to its section (instantly with reduced motion) and moves keyboard focus there; while scrolling, the link of the section in view is highlighted (aria-current). Many links scroll sideways with faded edges; the highlighted link is kept visible. Each link is a local block: label + target — the id of an element on the page or the section's key from the template JSON (e.g. "faq"); several targets separated by commas count as one link.
entries.use_when: long product pages or landing pages (Highlights · Features · Specs · FAQs), brand stories, guides.

settings.label: Name for screen readers
settings.info: Default: "On this page".

settings.label: Stay in view below the header
settings.info: The bar follows the page while scrolling.

entries.name: Announcement bar
entries.description: Thin bar above the header with one or more short messages ("Announcement" blocks: text, optional mobile text, link and icon). Messages rotate one at a time (auto-advance interval, optional arrows, visible pause button) or scroll as a marquee (loop time, direction; pauses on hover/focus, has a pause button and stays still for reduced motion). Optional social icons and country/language selectors on desktop; can be hidden on the home page. Hidden when it has nothing to show.
entries.use_when: header group only, for store-wide notices (shipping policy, returns, launch news). Only state real offers — no fake urgency.

settings.label: Change automatically
settings.info: A pause button is always shown next to the messages.

settings.label: Show arrows
settings.info: Always shown when messages do not change automatically.

settings.label: Time for one full loop
settings.info: Higher is slower. The marquee pauses on hover and focus, and stays still for reduced motion.

settings.label: Show social icons
settings.info: Links come from Theme settings → Social media.

settings.label: Show country/region selector
settings.info: Appears only when the store sells in more than one country or language.

entries.name: Blog posts
entries.description: Row of the latest posts from one blog, with heading, optional text and "View all" link. On an article page with no blog chosen it uses the current blog, leaves out the post being read and can list posts that share its tags first ("related posts"). Hidden entirely when there are no posts to show (a hint appears only in the theme editor). Two layouts: a grid (swipe row or stack on mobile), or "lead + list" — the first post large with its text over the image, the next posts as horizontal cards beside it.
entries.use_when: "From the blog" on the home page or landing pages, and related / latest posts under an article.

settings.label: Blog
settings.info: Leave empty on blog post pages to show more posts from the same blog. Elsewhere the section stays hidden until a blog is chosen.

settings.label: Leave out the post being read
Show posts with the same tags first
settings.info: On blog post pages only.

settings.label: Show "View all" link
settings.info: Appears only when the blog has more posts than shown.

settings.label: Text on the large post
settings.info: Pick a scheme whose text color stands out on your images.

settings.label: Show icons in the date line
settings.info: Calendar and clock icons before the date and reading time.

settings.label: Show comment count
settings.info: Only when comments are enabled for the blog.

settings.label: Show excerpt
settings.info: Write an excerpt when editing the post; otherwise the first words of the post are used.

entries.name: Bundle builder
entries.description: "Build your bundle": up to 12 chosen products as cards (image, rating chip, vendor, title, price, variant menu, "Add to bundle" button) next to a "Your bundle" panel — sticky in the right column on desktop, a bar stuck to the bottom of the screen on phones that opens to show the list. The panel lists the picked items with Remove buttons, a progress bar toward the minimum number of items, the note text (e.g. "Add 3 products to save 30%"), the total and one "Add bundle to cart" button that stays disabled until the minimum is reached and adds everything in one request. Changes are announced to screen readers; the selection survives page reloads in the same tab. The theme never applies a discount itself — create an automatic discount in Shopify admin to honour the note.
entries.use_when: home or landing pages that sell "pick any 3" / "mix and match" sets. For a fixed set of add-ons on the product page use the product-addons block.

settings.label: Maximum items
settings.info: Raised to the minimum when set lower.

settings.label: Allow the same product more than once
settings.info: Off: a product can be added once (any one of its variants).

settings.label: Note
settings.info: Short promise under the heading, e.g. "Add 3 products to save 30%". Only promise a discount you have created in admin.

entries.name: Cart drawer
entries.description: Slide-in cart opened from the header cart icon, the mobile dock and after "Add to cart". Free-shipping progress bar, line items with quantity controls, product recommendations based on the first item (with quick add), order note (saved as you type), optional "agree to terms" checkbox that blocks checkout until ticked, subtotal and checkout. When empty: collection tiles and a continue-shopping link. All options live in Theme settings → Cart. Rendered once by the layout; re-rendered through the Section Rendering API after every cart change.
entries.use_when: never add to templates — the layout renders it when Theme settings → Cart → Cart type is "Drawer".

entries.name: Cart recommendations
entries.description: Product recommendations inside the cart drawer: Shopify recommendations for the first cart item (related or complementary — Theme settings → Cart), skipping products already in the cart, as compact rows with image, title, price and a quick "Add" button for products with one variant (including a single named option such as one colour) ("Choose" links to the product otherwise). Loaded by the cart drawer when it opens; empty when there is nothing to recommend.
entries.use_when: never add to templates — requested by the cart drawer through routes.product_recommendations_url.

entries.name: Collage
entries.description: Bento-style collage on a 12-column grid: image, video, product and collection tiles, each spanning its own number of columns and rows, with an optional heading above. Tiles keep their order (no gap-filling reshuffle), so reading and tab order match what shoppers see; on mobile tiles stack full width or pair up at half width.
entries.use_when: mood boards, shop-by-category mosaics, a campaign wall mixing lifestyle images, a video and hero products.

settings.label: Heading highlight
settings.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

settings.label: Text colors
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

entries.name: Collection list
entries.description: Cards linking to chosen collections: collection image (or its first product's image), title below or over the image, optional product count read out with the title and an optional subtitle (the collection description's first words, or one line of text for every card). Two card styles: plain (image with the title below or over it) and tile (a light panel with the image contained inside, the title with the product count as a small superscript number, the subtitle and an arrow). Grid or scrolling row on desktop, swipe row or stacked grid on mobile, with previous/next buttons when it scrolls. Optional heading group and a "View all" link to the collections page.
entries.use_when: "Shop by category / room / character" entry points on the home page or landing pages. For hand-made tiles with custom text use "image-cards".

settings.label: Show "View all" link to all collections
Subtitle text
settings.info: For example "Shop now".

settings.label: Text colors
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

entries.name: Complementary (script)
entries.description: Compact list of Shopify "complementary" product recommendations with quick add buttons. Never shown on its own: the product-complementary block fetches it through the recommendations endpoint (?section_id=complementary-products&intent=complementary) and inserts the list.
entries.use_when: never add to templates — the product-complementary block loads it.

entries.name: Contact form
entries.description: Contact form that sends to the store's customer-service email through Shopify's own contact form (Shopify adds its spam protection). Name, email, phone and message fields with separate show / required switches, labels above the fields or inside them, extra custom fields as child blocks (short text, long text, checkbox, radio buttons, dropdown), prefilled for signed-in customers. After sending, a success or error message appears at the top and receives focus; fields keep what the visitor typed. Contact details (address, email, phone, opening hours, social icons) as "Contact detail" blocks beside the form or as a row of cards below it — plain, in a tinted box or as bordered cards. Layout "With map" puts a Google Maps view of the store address (no API key) beside the form, with the heading above the form. Optional heading group (sizes up to display) and privacy note.
entries.use_when: the contact page (with or without a map), wholesale or press enquiry pages, warranty or support request pages.

settings.label: Heading tag
settings.info: Use H1 when this is the first heading on the page.

settings.label: Layout
settings.info: "With map" shows a map of the store address beside the form; contact details go below.

settings.label: Contact details style
settings.info: Applies to the details text and the "Contact detail" blocks.

settings.label: Field labels
settings.info: "Inside the fields" shows each label as placeholder text; screen readers still read the label.

settings.label: Address
settings.info: Street address or place name as you would type it into Google Maps. No API key needed.

settings.label: Fallback image
settings.info: Shown when no address is set, and as the preview when the map loads on click.

settings.label: Load map on click
settings.info: Shows the fallback image with a "Show map" button; nothing is loaded from Google until the visitor presses it. Useful where cookie consent is required.

settings.label: Minimum map height on desktop
settings.info: The map grows with the form next to it.

settings.label: Button label
settings.info: Leave empty for "Send".

settings.label: Success message
settings.info: Leave empty for the default thank-you message.

settings.label: Privacy note
settings.info: Shown under the form, e.g. a link to your privacy policy.

settings.label: Contact details
settings.info: Shown beside the form: email, phone, hours, address. Connect shop metafields to keep them in one place.

entries.name: Container
entries.description: Free-form layout section. Arranges any theme blocks (heading, text, button, image, group, app blocks, custom blocks) in a row or a column, on a chosen color surface.
entries.use_when: building new page content from existing blocks; placing a custom block on a page; landing pages; any content that has no dedicated section.

entries.name: Cookie banner
entries.description: Cookie consent banner connected to Shopify's Customer Privacy API: appears only to visitors who must be asked (e.g. in the EU) and have not answered yet, with Accept, Decline and an optional "Preferences" panel (analytics, marketing, personalisation) plus a privacy policy link. It is a small card, not a modal: the page stays scrollable and usable (including touch scrolling). Test mode shows it on every load and in the editor.
entries.use_when: the "Overlays" section group only, when you want a themed banner instead of Shopify's own (turn Shopify's banner off in Settings → Customer privacy).

settings.label: Test mode
settings.info: Shows on every page load for everyone, and in the editor. Turn off before going live.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: We use cookies to run the store, understand how it is used and show relevant content. Choose which cookies you allow.

settings.label: Privacy policy link
settings.info: Leave empty to use the store's privacy policy.

settings.label: Show "Manage preferences"
settings.info: Lets visitors choose analytics, marketing and personalization cookies separately.

entries.name: Countdown
entries.description: Countdown to a real deadline: the merchant types the end date (YYYY-MM-DD) and time (HH:MM, store time zone); with an impossible or missing date the section stays hidden on the storefront (the editor shows a hint). Two looks: a banner (optional background image with overlay, heading, text, large timer, button) or a slim one-line bar that also fits in the header group. After the deadline the timer disappears and either an "ended" message shows or the whole section hides — also when the page was cached before the deadline.
entries.use_when: a sale, drop or pre-order window that really ends at a specific time. Never for fake urgency: no looping or per-visitor timers.

settings.label: End date
settings.info: Format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-12-31. An invalid date shows no timer.

settings.label: End time
settings.info: 24-hour format HH:MM, e.g. 18:00. Leave empty for midnight.

settings.label: Ended message
settings.info: Replaces the timer after the deadline. Leave empty to show nothing.

settings.label: Layout
settings.info: Use the bar in the header group for a slim site-wide strip.

settings.label: Color scheme
settings.info: With a background image, pick a scheme whose text contrasts with the image.

entries.name: FAQ
entries.description: Questions and answers as an accordion (native details / summary, keyboard and screen-reader friendly). Several answers open at once or only one at a time; optionally the first one starts open. Optional categories: headings between questions or one bordered card per category (heading, short text, its questions), with optional jump links to each category above the list, a heading group on top and a "still have questions?" contact panel beside (desktop) or below (mobile) — text, a button and/or a contact form (Shopify's contact form: name, email, optional phone, message) in its own color scheme. Layout "Card" puts the questions and the contact panel together in one rounded card, with the description in a tinted note beside the heading. Can output FAQPage structured data built only from the questions actually shown — off by default.
entries.use_when: FAQ pages, product-page questions, shipping / returns / sizing explanations, setup help. Answers can be connected to product or page metafields (dynamic sources) so one answer is maintained once and reused on several templates.

settings.label: Category style
settings.info: How "Category" blocks look. "Cards" puts each category and its questions in a bordered card.

settings.label: Show category links
settings.info: A row of links above the questions that jump to each category.

settings.label: Layout
settings.info: Card: the questions and the contact panel share one rounded card in the section color scheme.

settings.label: Output FAQ structured data
settings.info: Adds FAQPage data for search engines, built only from the questions and answers in this section. Turn on only when every answer is real and current.

settings.label: Show a contact form
settings.info: Messages go to the store's customer-service email through Shopify's contact form.

settings.label: Field labels
settings.info: "Inside the fields" shows each label as placeholder text; screen readers still read the label.

entries.name: Featured collection
entries.description: Heading, optional text and "View all" link above products from one collection: a grid, or on desktop a one-row carousel with previous / next buttons next to the heading. On mobile the grid can become a swipeable row. Cards can show spec icons (custom.highlights metafield) and the rating as a chip on the image.
entries.use_when: showing products on the home page or landing pages ("Best sellers", "New arrivals", a product line).

settings.label: Desktop layout
settings.info: Carousel shows one row with previous / next buttons beside the heading. Mobile follows "Mobile layout".

settings.label: Show quick add on product cards
settings.info: A "+" button adds single-variant products at once and opens a quick view window for products with options.

settings.label: Show spec icons on product cards
settings.info: Up to 3 icons from the product metafield custom.highlights (list of single line texts, one "icon: text" per line, e.g. "battery: 38 h battery").

settings.label: Show rating on the card image
settings.info: A small "★ 4.5" chip in the corner of the image instead of the star row. Needs Theme settings → Product cards → Show rating and a reviews app.

entries.name: Featured collections tabs
entries.description: Up to five collections behind a row of tabs ("New in / Best sellers / Sale"), each showing a product grid or a scrolling row with previous/next buttons and a "View all" link. Accessible tabs: arrow keys, Home / End, only the selected tab in the Tab order. Only the first tab's products are in the initial page; the others load in one request when the visitor first points at, focuses or selects the tabs.
entries.use_when: the home page or landing pages need several product sets in the space of one ("Shop by line", "Pro / Lite"). For one collection use "featured-collection".

settings.label: Show spec icons on product cards
settings.info: Up to 3 icons from the product metafield custom.highlights (list of single line texts, one "icon: text" per line, e.g. "battery: 38 h battery").

settings.label: Show rating on the card image
settings.info: A small "★ 4.5" chip in the corner of the image instead of the star row. Needs Theme settings → Product cards → Show rating and a reviews app.

entries.name: Featured product
entries.description: One chosen product with its full buy box on any page: media gallery (slider with thumbnails or a 2-column grid, full-screen zoom) next to a column of the same blocks as the product page (title, price, rating, badges, variant picker, stock, buy buttons, add-ons, highlights, trust rows, description, collapsible rows, app blocks…) and a "View full details" link. Shoppers switch variants and add to cart without leaving the page; the address bar does not change. Optional round rotating text badge on the gallery (decorative, stops for reduced motion).
entries.use_when: home page or landing pages that spotlight one product ("Hero product", "New release"). For the product page itself use main-product.

settings.label: Desktop gallery layout
settings.info: Phones always show a swipeable slider.

settings.label: Thumbnails
settings.info: Beside: a scrollable column at the start of the large image. None: dots under the image.

settings.label: Image column width
settings.info: Share of the row the images take on screens 1280 px and wider. Between 750 and 1279 px the details column keeps a readable width and the images take the rest.

settings.label: Custom image column width
settings.info: 30% is under a third of the row, 50% half, 75% three quarters.

settings.label: Keep the shorter column in view while scrolling
settings.info: Desktop: the details column (or the images, in the slider layout) stays below the header while the page scrolls.

settings.label: Image shape
settings.info: "Match first image" gives every slide the first image's shape. "Each image's own shape" lets the slider grow and shrink with the current image.

settings.label: Image zoom
settings.info: Let shoppers enlarge product images.

settings.label: Zoom style
settings.info: Magnifier: with a mouse, clicking an image shows it at 2× where the pointer is (click again or move away to close). Touch screens and keyboard open the full-screen viewer.

settings.label: Magnifier button on phones
settings.info: Phones show a small magnifier button on each image that opens the zoom; tapping the image itself only swipes.

settings.label: Show only the selected variant's images
settings.info: Hides images attached to other variants. To give a value several images, end their alt text with a tag, e.g. "Side view #color:black". Several values: "#color:black,blue"; several options: "#color:black,size:large". Tagged images show only while a listed value is selected; untagged images always show. The tag is not read out to screen readers. The older form "#Color:Black | Side view" still works.

settings.label: Autoplay videos
settings.info: Uploaded videos play muted while visible; not for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Badge text
settings.info: Written around a slowly turning circle on the gallery. Leave empty to hide. Repeat short text to fill the circle, e.g. "New release • New release • ". Decorative: screen readers skip it and it stays still for visitors who reduce motion.

entries.name: Features
entries.description: Row of short selling points, each with an icon (built-in set or uploaded image), a title and one line of text. Optional heading above.
entries.use_when: key product facts ("Bluetooth 5.4", "IPX7 washable"), store promises (shipping, returns, secure checkout), "why us" rows.

entries.name: Floating side bar
entries.description: Slim vertical pill fixed to the left or right edge of the screen, vertically centered: the store's social links (Theme settings → Social media) and an optional vertical tab button, e.g. "Newsletter", that reopens the newsletter popup (or follows a link when the popup is not on the page). Frosted translucent surface with a thin border. Can fade away while shoppers scroll down and come back when they scroll up. Shown from desktop width (990px) up; on phones and tablets only when switched on, and then without the social links by default so it stays small. Keyboard reachable; nothing moves with reduced motion. Can be limited to the home page, where it usually sits over a full-screen banner instead of page content.
entries.use_when: the "Overlays" section group only (rendered on every page by the layout) — a persistent "follow us" / "get 10% off" handle at the screen edge.

settings.label: Show on
settings.info: The bar floats over the page edge; on pages with sidebars (collection filters) "Home page only" keeps it off the content.

settings.label: Show social links
settings.info: Uses the links in Theme settings → Social media.

settings.label: Tab label
settings.info: Opens the newsletter popup when it is on for this page. Leave empty to hide the tab.

settings.label: Tab link
settings.info: Used when the newsletter popup is off or not shown on this page. Without a link the tab then stays hidden.

settings.label: Hide while scrolling down
settings.info: Comes back as soon as shoppers scroll up.

settings.label: Hide social links on mobile
settings.info: Keeps the bar small so it does not cover content.

entries.name: Footer
entries.description: Store footer. Holds any theme blocks (logo, menu columns that fold into accordions on phones, text, email sign-up, social links, country/language selectors, app blocks) above a copyright line with optional policy links, payment icons and an optional legal / licensing notice.
entries.use_when: footer group only.

settings.label: Show policy links
settings.info: Refund, privacy, terms, shipping and contact pages from Settings → Policies.

settings.label: Legal notice
settings.info: Trademark, licensing or company registration text shown under the copyright line.

entries.name: Header
entries.description: Store header: logo, main menu (six desktop layouts incl. centered logo, split menu and drawer-only menu), dropdowns and mega menus with optional promo cards ("Mega menu" blocks), search (opens the search drawer or goes to the search page), customer account, cart with live item count and optional country/language selectors. Sticky modes: off, always, or hide while scrolling down. Becomes transparent over the first section when that section allows it: any section whose output carries a data-transparent-header attribute (Hero, Slideshow, Video, Reveal image with text → Transparent header). On mobile (and in drawer layouts) the menu opens in a side drawer with accordion or sliding sub-menus.
entries.use_when: header group only. Do not add to page templates. Menu items come from Online Store → Navigation; the logo from Theme settings → Logo.

settings.label: Menu
settings.info: Edit menus in Online Store → Navigation. Three levels open as a wide panel.

settings.label: Current page indicator
settings.info: Also shown when hovering a menu item.

settings.label: Menu button label
settings.info: Shown next to the menu icon from 750px up. Leave blank for the icon only.

settings.label: Show social icons in the menu drawer
settings.info: Links come from Theme settings → Social media.

settings.label: Show account
settings.info: Only when customer accounts are turned on.

settings.label: Show country/region selector
settings.info: Appears only when the store sells in more than one country or language.

settings.label: Transparent header colors
settings.info: Used over the first section when it allows a transparent header (Hero → Transparent header). Only its text color is used; upload a light logo in Theme settings → Logo.

entries.name: Image banner
entries.description: Full-width banner: background image (separate mobile image optional) or looping video, darkening overlay, and any blocks (heading, text, buttons, groups) placed in one of nine positions. Can also sit inside the page width as a rounded card with space around it.
entries.use_when: first screen of the home page, campaign landing pages, collection intros — any large image with text on top.

settings.label: Mobile image
settings.info: Optional. Use a portrait image for phones.

settings.label: Background video
settings.info: Plays muted on loop instead of the image.

settings.label: Text colors
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

settings.label: Transparent header
settings.info: When this is the first section on the page, the header sits on top of it without a background.

settings.label: Full width
settings.info: Off: the banner sits inside the page width with rounded corners.

settings.label: Background around the banner
settings.info: Color scheme of the space around the banner when it is not full width.

entries.name: Image cards
entries.description: Row of large image cards, each with a title, short text and link laid over the bottom of the image. Two to four per row on desktop; swipe row or stack on mobile.
entries.use_when: shop-by-category entry points, two-way splits (e.g. "Pro / Lite", "Men / Women"), campaign tiles.

settings.label: Text colors
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

entries.name: Image comparison
entries.description: Before/after image comparison: two images stacked with a draggable divider (left/right or up/down). The divider is a real range input, so it works with arrow keys, Home/End and screen readers; drag or tap anywhere on the image with mouse or touch. Optional labels on each side, start position, optional heading above. Shows an editor warning when both sides use the same image.
entries.use_when: showing a transformation or difference — before/after installation, cleaning, repair, two materials or finishes side by side.

settings.label: Heading highlight
settings.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

settings.label: After image
settings.info: Use a different photo of the same scene, taken from the same angle and with the same size.

settings.label: Divider and label colors
settings.info: Pick a scheme that stands out on your images.

entries.name: Image with text
entries.description: Large image beside a column of blocks (eyebrow, heading, text, buttons, feature lists). Image left or right on desktop, stacked on mobile. Image style "overlap" layers a second, smaller image over the first, both slightly rotated (0–8°) in opposite directions like a collage; the small image drifts a little while scrolling (not with reduced motion). Layout "Card" joins image and text into one rounded card: the text sits on a panel in its own color scheme and the image fills the other half edge to edge.
entries.use_when: spotlighting one product or story ("Meet the X1 Pro"), brand story, about-page chapters.

settings.label: Image style
settings.info: "Overlapping images" layers a smaller second image over the first, both slightly rotated.

settings.label: Second image
settings.info: Smaller image placed over the first one. Shows a placeholder until you choose one.

settings.label: Rotation
settings.info: How far the two images lean in opposite directions. 0 keeps them straight.

settings.label: Layout
settings.info: "Card" joins image and text into one rounded card with a colored text panel.

entries.name: Text with inline images
entries.description: Big centred statement with small rounded images between the words, like "We make [chair photo] furniture for [sofa photo] real homes". Type the sentence once and put [image1], [image2] … where the "Image" blocks should appear (first block = [image1]); images without a placeholder follow the last word. Italic words get the heading highlight. Images are sized relative to the text, so they shrink with it on mobile, and settle from a slight zoom as they scroll in (not with reduced motion).
entries.use_when: a brand statement or collection intro that mixes words and product or lifestyle pictures; a playful manifesto line between sections.

settings.label: Text
settings.info: Type [image1], [image2] … where the image blocks should appear. Images without a placeholder follow the last word. Italic words get the heading highlight.
settings.default: Made for play [image1] built to last [image2] and shared with the people you love

settings.label: Heading highlight
settings.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

settings.label: HTML tag
settings.info: For SEO. Does not change the look.

settings.label: Image height
settings.info: Relative to the text size, so images shrink with the text on mobile.

entries.name: Logo list
entries.description: Row of partner, press or certification logos as a wrapping grid or a slowly scrolling strip. The strip has a pause button, pauses on hover and keyboard focus, and stays still for visitors who prefer reduced motion. Logos can be grayscale (color on hover); each logo has a brand name used as its alt text and link name, so linked logos are reachable and named for keyboard and screen-reader users.
entries.use_when: "As seen in" press bars, retailer or partner logos, certifications and awards, payment or shipping partner rows.

settings.label: Show logos in grayscale
settings.info: Logos turn to color on hover and keyboard focus.

entries.name: Lookbook
entries.description: Shoppable image ("shop the look"): a lifestyle image with up to 8 hotspots. Each hotspot is a keyboard-reachable button with a pulsing dot that opens a small card — product (image, title, price, Add to cart for single-variant products, otherwise "Choose options") or a note (heading, text, link). Cards show on hover/focus and stay open on click; on phones they open as a bottom sheet. Optional numbered product list beside the image.
entries.use_when: showing products in use or in a room, "shop the look", explaining features on a photo, annotated product images.

settings.label: Heading highlight
settings.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

settings.label: Mobile image
settings.info: Optional. When set, hotspots use their mobile positions on phones.

settings.label: Hotspot colors
settings.info: Pick a scheme whose background stands out on your image.

entries.name: 404 page
entries.description: "Page not found" page: optional "404" line, heading (heading or display size) and message (editable, with sensible defaults), an optional search box, buttons to the home page and the catalog (either one can be the main button), and optional popular links (from a menu) and popular collections.
entries.use_when: templates/404.json only.

settings.label: Heading
settings.info: Leave empty to use "Page not found" in the store's language.

settings.label: Message
settings.info: Leave empty to use the default message in the store's language.

settings.label: Popular links
settings.info: Pick a menu from Online Store → Navigation.

settings.label: Popular links heading
settings.info: Leave empty to use the menu's name.

entries.name: Customer account
entries.description: "My account" dashboard (classic accounts): greeting with name and email, log-out button, order history table (order, date, payment, fulfillment, total; cards on phones; paginated) with a "Start shopping" prompt when there are no orders, and a side panel with the default address and a link to manage addresses.
entries.use_when: templates/customers/account.json only.

entries.name: Activate account
entries.description: Account activation (classic accounts, from the invitation email): set a password and confirm it, with errors next to the fields. "Decline invitation" is a separate form, so it works without filling in the password.
entries.use_when: templates/customers/activate_account.json only.

entries.name: Customer addresses
entries.description: Address book (classic accounts): address cards (default first, labelled), "Add a new address", edit and delete for each address. Add / edit forms open in a dialog with country → province lists; a form that comes back with errors reopens on its own and shows them. Deleting asks for confirmation in a themed dialog. Friendly message when there are no addresses.
entries.use_when: templates/customers/addresses.json only.

entries.name: Blog post
entries.description: Blog post page: tags, title and meta (date, author, reading time, comments) centred or start-aligned (tags and meta on one line above the title), cover image as a full-width banner behind the title (optionally under a transparent header, with the post body rising over the banner's bottom edge) or inline below it, an optional reading progress bar, a table of contents built from the post's headings (above the text or in a sticky side column), the post content (optional large centred quote style), an author box, any blocks you add (share, custom Liquid, apps), share links with the comment count, previous / next post cards and comments with the comment form — plain or grouped in a tinted panel. Outputs article structured data.
entries.use_when: templates/article*.json only. Put related posts below it with the "Blog posts" section.

settings.label: Title alignment
settings.info: Start: tags and date on one line above the title.

settings.label: Show comment count
settings.info: Only when comments are enabled for the blog.

settings.label: Show icons in the date line
settings.info: Calendar and clock icons before the date and reading time.

settings.label: Fallback image
settings.info: Only used for posts that have no featured image of their own.

settings.label: Text colors on the banner
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

settings.label: Transparent header over the banner
settings.info: Only when this section is the first on the page.

settings.label: Post body overlaps the banner
settings.info: The text area starts with rounded corners over the bottom of the banner.

settings.label: Table of contents
settings.info: Built from the post's headings; hidden when the post has fewer than two.

settings.label: Show reading progress bar
settings.info: A thin bar at the top of the window fills as the visitor reads.

settings.label: Show author box
settings.info: Name, photo and bio of the staff account that wrote the post (Settings → Users).

settings.label: Share, next post and comments
settings.info: Panel groups them on a light tinted background below the post.

settings.label: Show share links
settings.info: Networks follow Theme settings → Social media. Hidden when you add a Share block to this section.

settings.label: Show comment count beside share links
settings.info: Only when comments are enabled for the blog.

settings.label: Show date and author on previous / next posts
Comments per page
settings.info: Comments appear only when they are enabled for the blog (Online Store → Blog posts → Manage blogs).

entries.name: Blog posts list
entries.description: Blog listing: blog title, optional intro, tag filter ("All" + every tag) as pill chips or as text links with slash separators, which scrolls sideways or turns into a dropdown on phones; post cards in a grid, list, "lead post" or collage layout (first post large with its text over the image, the next two beside it, then a grid), and pagination. Card details (image shape, tags on the image or above the text, date / reading time with icons, author, comments, excerpt) are switchable. Shows a friendly message when the blog (or the chosen tag) has no posts.
entries.use_when: templates/blog*.json only.

settings.label: Show tag filter
settings.info: Lists every tag used in this blog. Scrolls sideways on phones.

settings.label: Layout
settings.info: Collage: the first post large with its text over the image and the next two beside it (first page only; phones always stack).

settings.label: Text colors on the first post
settings.info: Used over the image of the large first post in the collage.

settings.label: Show tags
settings.info: Optional: give an article a color metafield custom.tag_color to color its tags.

settings.label: Show icons in the date line
settings.info: Calendar and clock icons before the date and reading time.

settings.label: Show comment count
settings.info: Only when comments are enabled for the blog.

settings.label: Show excerpt
settings.info: Write an excerpt when editing the post; otherwise the first words of the post are used.

entries.name: Cart
entries.description: Cart page: heading with an optional "Continue shopping" button, line items (compact, or table columns for quantity and line total, optional vendor), free-shipping progress (Theme settings → Cart) above the lines or in the summary, optional whole-order gift wrap (a product you choose, with an optional gift message saved as a cart attribute), product recommendations, estimated shipping rates by country and postal code, discount codes (several can be combined, each removable), then a summary panel (outlined or tinted) with order note (collapsible or always open, saved as you type), cart discounts, subtotal, optional "agree to terms" checkbox that blocks checkout until ticked, checkout (plus accelerated checkout buttons, hidden while the terms checkbox is required because they would skip it) and accepted payment icons. When empty: a centred message with an icon and a continue-shopping button. Works without JavaScript through the native cart form (discount codes, shipping estimates and gift wrap need it).
entries.use_when: cart template only (templates/cart.json).

settings.label: Free shipping progress
settings.info: Set the amount in Theme settings → Cart.

settings.label: Show product recommendations
settings.info: Uses the recommendation settings in Theme settings → Cart.

settings.label: Gift wrap product
settings.info: Shows a "Gift wrap this order" checkbox that adds one of this product. Create it as a product with a price (and hide it from collections).

settings.label: Ask for a gift message
settings.info: Saved with the order as a cart attribute.

settings.label: Show shipping estimate
settings.info: Shoppers enter a country and postal code to see your shipping rates.

settings.label: Show discount code field
settings.info: Several codes can be combined when your discounts allow it.

entries.name: Collection products
entries.description: Collection page: header in three styles (plain title, full-width image banner that can sit under a transparent store header, or text beside the image) with optional breadcrumb (plus BreadcrumbList data); subcollection links (tabs, pills or image chips, from a collection list or found in a menu) in the header or toolbar; filters as a sidebar, a drawer or a row of dropdowns (always a drawer on phones), active filter chips, sorting, a desktop column switch; product grid with promo tiles ("Promo tile" blocks: image or video, placed at a grid position on the first page); page numbers, a "Load more" button or infinite scroll. Filtering, sorting and loading more update without reloading.
entries.use_when: collection templates (templates/collection*.json). Filters come from the Search & Discovery app.

settings.label: Header image
settings.info: Leave empty to use the collection's own image.

settings.label: Show breadcrumb
settings.info: Home › Collections › collection name, also shared with search engines.

settings.label: Transparent header over the banner
settings.info: Works when this section is first on the page. Set the header colors in Header → Transparent header colors.

settings.label: Header colors
settings.info: Text colors on the banner, or the colors of the text panel beside the image.

settings.label: Subcollection links
settings.info: Menu: the links under the current collection in that menu (or its siblings), up to three levels deep.

settings.label: Collections
settings.info: Used when Subcollection links is "Chosen collections". The same links show on every collection that uses this template.

settings.label: Menu
settings.info: Usually the main menu. Only links to collections are used.

settings.label: Show column switch
settings.info: Lets shoppers choose how many products per row on desktop. The choice is remembered.

settings.label: Pagination
settings.info: With "Load more" and infinite scroll, shoppers without JavaScript still get a link to the next page.

settings.label: Show quick add on product cards
settings.info: A "+" button adds single-variant products at once and opens a quick view window for products with options.

settings.label: Show spec icons on product cards
settings.info: Up to 3 icons from the product metafield custom.highlights (list of single line texts, one "icon: text" per line, e.g. "battery: 38 h battery").

settings.label: Show rating on the card image
settings.info: A small "★ 4.5" chip in the corner of the image instead of the star row. Needs Theme settings → Product cards → Show rating and a reviews app.

settings.label: Keep promo tiles while filtering
settings.info: Promo tiles show on the first page only.

settings.label: Enable filters
settings.info: Choose filters with the Search & Discovery app.

settings.label: Filter layout
settings.info: On phones and tablets filters always open in a drawer.

entries.name: Collections list
entries.description: "All collections" page: a grid of collection tiles with a page heading. Tile styles: plain (image, title and count below), tile (light panel with the image inside, title with the count as a superscript, subtitle, arrow) or overlay (text over the image); the first tile can be shown over its image to stand out. Optional subtitle from each collection's description. Shows every collection (paginated) or only the ones you pick, sorted alphabetically, by product count or by date.
entries.use_when: templates/list-collections.json (the /collections page).

settings.label: Collections
settings.info: Leave empty to show every collection.

settings.label: Sort collections
settings.info: With all collections, sorting applies within each page.

settings.label: Show the first collection over its image
settings.info: Makes the first tile stand out, e.g. "All products" with a photo.

settings.label: Text colors
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

entries.name: Customer login
entries.description: Customer login (classic accounts): email and password, "Forgot your password?" view on the same page (works without JavaScript; focus moves to the new heading), success message after a reset email is sent, errors next to the fields, optional "Sign in with Shop" button and "Continue as guest" when checkout allows it.
entries.use_when: templates/customers/login.json only.

settings.label: Show "Sign in with Shop"
settings.info: Requires Shop Pay to be active for the store.

entries.name: Order details
entries.description: Order details (classic accounts): heading with the order number, order date, cancellation notice, line items (product link, variant, selling plan, custom properties, line discounts, fulfillment with tracking link, SKU, price, quantity, total), totals with one row per order discount, shipping method and tax line, duties, refunds and the grand total; billing and shipping addresses with payment and fulfillment status.
entries.use_when: templates/customers/order.json only.

entries.name: Page
entries.description: Renders a Shopify page (title and content from Online Store → Pages), followed by optional theme blocks.
entries.use_when: templates/page*.json only.

entries.name: Password page
entries.description: Password page shown while the store is closed: top bar with logo and an "Enter using password" button (the password form opens in a dialog that reopens by itself after a wrong password), heading and message (defaults to the password message from Preferences), optional email sign-up with a consent line (the form hides after signing up), optional background image with overlay, and a footer with "Powered by Shopify" and the store-owner login link.
entries.use_when: templates/password.json only.

settings.label: Heading
settings.info: Leave empty to show the store name.

settings.label: Message
settings.info: Leave empty to use the message from Online Store → Preferences → Password protection.

settings.label: Show email sign-up
settings.info: Sign-ups become customers tagged "newsletter" and "password-page".

settings.label: Sign-up heading
settings.default: Be the first to know when we open.

settings.label: Consent line
settings.info: Short note under the form, e.g. that people can unsubscribe at any time. Link your privacy policy here.
settings.default: By signing up you agree to receive emails from us. You can unsubscribe at any time.

settings.label: Text colors on the image
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

settings.label: Color scheme
settings.info: Used when there is no background image.

settings.label: Show footer (Powered by Shopify, owner login)

entries.name: Product information
entries.description: Product page: media gallery (slider with thumbnails below, beside the image or none/dots, 2-column grid, stacked column or "featured" — first image large, the others in a narrow column; image shape matching the first image, each image's own or a fixed ratio; full-screen zoom or a click-to-magnify 2× lens; phone slides full width or 75% with dots, thumbnails or a counter; optional "only the selected variant's images" with alt-text tags) next to a column of blocks (title, price, badges, rating, variant picker, stock, buy buttons, add-ons, pickup, description, specifications, highlights, trust rows, pop-up links, countdown, complementary products, collapsible rows, text, app blocks). Image column width is a preset or a custom percentage (30–75%) on wide screens; the shorter column can stay in view while scrolling. Price, picker, stock, SKU and buy buttons update in place when the shopper picks another variant. Optional sticky add-to-cart bar once the buy button scrolls away. Records the product for the "Recently viewed" section. Blocks with a "Placement: below the images" setting (spec tiles, icon list) move under the gallery on desktop while the info column stays sticky; on phones they follow the info column.
entries.use_when: product templates (templates/product*.json). Change what appears in the info column by adding, removing or reordering its blocks; change the gallery in the section settings.

settings.label: Desktop gallery layout
settings.info: Phones always show a swipeable slider.

settings.label: Thumbnails
settings.info: Beside: a scrollable column at the start of the large image. None: dots under the image.

settings.label: Image column width
settings.info: Share of the row the images take on screens 1280 px and wider. Between 750 and 1279 px the details column keeps a readable width and the images take the rest.

settings.label: Custom image column width
settings.info: 30% is under a third of the row, 50% half, 75% three quarters.

settings.label: Keep the shorter column in view while scrolling
settings.info: Desktop: the details column (or the images, in the slider layout) stays below the header while the page scrolls.

settings.label: Image shape
settings.info: "Match first image" gives every slide the first image's shape. "Each image's own shape" lets the slider grow and shrink with the current image.

settings.label: Image zoom
settings.info: Let shoppers enlarge product images.

settings.label: Zoom style
settings.info: Magnifier: with a mouse, clicking an image shows it at 2× where the pointer is (click again or move away to close). Touch screens and keyboard open the full-screen viewer.

settings.label: Magnifier button on phones
settings.info: Phones show a small magnifier button on each image that opens the zoom; tapping the image itself only swipes.

settings.label: Show only the selected variant's images
settings.info: Hides images attached to other variants. To give a value several images, end their alt text with a tag, e.g. "Side view #color:black". Several values: "#color:black,blue"; several options: "#color:black,size:large". Tagged images show only while a listed value is selected; untagged images always show. The tag is not read out to screen readers. The older form "#Color:Black | Side view" still works.

settings.label: Autoplay videos
settings.info: Uploaded videos play muted while visible; not for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Show sticky add-to-cart bar
settings.info: Appears at the bottom of the screen once the Add to cart button scrolls out of view.

entries.name: Create account
entries.description: Create-account page (classic accounts): first name, last name, email, password (with show / hide), optional extra fields you add as blocks (saved to the customer note), optional email-marketing checkbox, errors next to each field with the entered values kept.
entries.use_when: templates/customers/register.json only. Add "Registration field" blocks to collect extra details.

settings.label: Terms / privacy note
settings.info: Shown above the button. Link your privacy policy or terms here.

entries.name: Reset password
entries.description: Reset password (classic accounts, from the reset email): new password and confirmation with show / hide, errors next to the fields, and a link back to login.
entries.use_when: templates/customers/reset_password.json only.

entries.name: Search results
entries.description: Search page: "Search" / "Search results" heading (size and alignment adjustable) with a search box and "Clear" link; results can include products only, or products with blog posts and pages (post cards with image, tags and date), with optional tabs to narrow to one type; product filters (sidebar, drawer or a row of dropdowns) and sorting, an optional desktop column switch, page numbers / "Load more" / infinite scroll (same grid as collections). When nothing matches: a clear message, optional "popular searches" links from a menu and products from a chosen collection. The same links show before anything is searched.
entries.use_when: search template only (templates/search.json).

settings.label: Search in
settings.info: Filters apply to products only.

settings.label: Show result type tabs
settings.info: "All / Products / Blog posts / Pages" links under the search box.

settings.label: Pagination
settings.info: With "Load more" and infinite scroll, shoppers without JavaScript still get a link to the next page.

settings.label: Show column switch
settings.info: Lets shoppers choose how many products per row on desktop. The choice is remembered.

settings.label: Filter layout
settings.info: On phones and tablets filters always open in a drawer.

settings.label: Show quick add on product cards
settings.info: A "+" button adds single-variant products at once and opens a quick view window for products with options.

settings.label: Show spec icons on product cards
settings.info: Up to 3 icons from the product metafield custom.highlights (list of single line texts, one "icon: text" per line, e.g. "battery: 38 h battery").

settings.label: Show rating on the card image
settings.info: A small "★ 4.5" chip in the corner of the image instead of the star row. Needs Theme settings → Product cards → Show rating and a reviews app.

settings.label: Popular searches menu
settings.info: Links shown before a search and when nothing matches. Point them at search pages or collections.

settings.label: Products to show when nothing matches
settings.info: Shown under the "no results" message. Leave empty to show nothing extra.

entries.name: Map
entries.description: Store map: a Google Maps view of one address (no API key; standard, grey, muted or dark tint) at a set height, with an optional info card built from any blocks (heading, text, contact details, opening hours, a "Get directions" button). On desktop the card floats over the map in one of six positions; on phones it sits below the map or stays over it. Optional "load on click" shows a fallback image first so nothing is loaded from Google until the visitor asks.
entries.use_when: store locations, showroom or pickup point pages, "Visit us" on the contact or about page, event venues.

settings.label: Address
settings.info: Street address or place name as you would type it into Google Maps. No API key needed.

settings.label: Fallback image
settings.info: Shown when no address is set, and as the preview when the map loads on click.

settings.label: Load map on click
settings.info: Shows the fallback image with a "Show map" button; nothing is loaded from Google until the visitor presses it. Useful where cookie consent is required.

settings.label: Info card position on desktop
settings.info: The card appears when the section has blocks.

entries.name: Marquee
entries.description: Scrolling strip of short phrases (brand values, product keywords, promo lines), optionally linked. One separator style for the whole strip (dot, slash, star or none); a phrase that already ends with its own separator gets no second one. Size, font, outline text, speed (pixels per second, never frantic), direction and an optional second row running the other way. Pause button, pauses on hover and focus, and stays still for reduced motion.
entries.use_when: a moving divider between sections, a keyword band under the header or above the footer, a campaign slogan strip. Put it in the header or footer group to show the same strip on every page instead of repeating it in templates.

settings.label: Separator
settings.info: Added after each phrase, unless the phrase already ends with its own separator.

settings.label: Outline text
settings.info: Works best with large text.

settings.label: Add a second row
settings.info: Repeats the phrases in the opposite direction, as decoration.

entries.name: Mobile dock
entries.description: App-style bar fixed to the bottom of the screen on phones (hidden from 750px up): up to six "Dock item" blocks — home, menu (opens the header's menu drawer), search (opens the search drawer), cart with live item count (opens the cart drawer), account, or any link with an icon. The current page is marked. Leaves space at the end of the page so it never covers the footer, and respects the iPhone home-indicator area.
entries.use_when: footer group (or header group), when shoppers on phones need one-tap access to menu, search and cart while scrolling.

entries.name: Multicolumn
entries.description: Two to six columns, each with an image or an icon (built-in set or uploaded SVG/PNG), a heading, text and an optional link. Plain, bordered-card or filled-card look; icons above or beside the text; on mobile a swipeable row with previous/next buttons or a stacked grid. Optional heading group with eyebrow, description and button.
entries.use_when: selling points, store promises (shipping, returns, warranty), spec strips ("150 cm", "IPX7"), how-it-works steps, comparisons, "shop by" entry points with images. Column text and images can be connected to product or page metafields (dynamic sources) so the same facts are maintained in one place.

entries.name: Newsletter popup
entries.description: Email sign-up popup that opens after a delay: heading, text, optional image (desktop only), email form with consent line, success / error message. Remembers a close for N days and a sign-up for a year; can be limited to the home page and hidden from logged-in customers. Accessible dialog: focus stays inside, Escape and the always-visible close button close it, focus returns afterwards; bottom sheet on phones. Test mode shows it on every load and while the section is selected in the editor.
entries.use_when: the "Overlays" section group only (rendered on every page by the layout).

settings.label: Test mode
settings.info: Shows on every page load and in the editor, ignoring the frequency. Turn off before going live.

settings.label: Show again after
settings.info: Days after a visitor closes it. Visitors who sign up are not asked again for a year.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Tell visitors what they get for signing up, for example news about launches and restocks.

settings.label: Button label
settings.info: Leave empty for "Sign up" in the store's language.

settings.label: Consent line
settings.info: Short note under the form, e.g. that people can unsubscribe at any time. Link your privacy policy here.
settings.default: By signing up you agree to receive emails from us. You can unsubscribe at any time.

settings.label: Image
settings.info: Shown beside the text on tablets and desktops only.

settings.label: Position
settings.info: On phones the popup always slides up from the bottom.

entries.name: Email sign-up
entries.description: Email sign-up: heading, short text and an email field that adds the shopper to Shopify customers with marketing consent. Shows a thank-you message after signing up.
entries.use_when: collecting newsletter subscribers on the home page, above the footer, or on landing pages.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: New releases and restocks, straight to your inbox.

settings.label: Small print
settings.info: E.g. a link to your privacy policy.

entries.name: People cards
entries.description: Portrait cards for people or portfolio pieces (designers, team members, athletes, case studies): image, name and role. "Overlay" cards put the name on a frosted panel over the image with a round "+" button; "Below" cards show name, role, a short bio excerpt and a "Read more" link under the image. The button opens a side panel with the full profile: image, role, bio, optional content of a store page and an optional link — or, with "Card button opens: Link", goes straight to the person's link (e.g. their profile page). Grid, swipe row with previous / next buttons, or "staggered": two columns with the left one set lower. The heading group sits above the cards or beside them (sticky on desktop), optional "View all" button.
entries.use_when: "Meet our designers", team / about pages, ambassadors, portfolio or case-study cards that need more text than fits on a card.

settings.label: Heading highlight
settings.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

settings.label: Heading position on desktop
settings.info: "Beside the cards" keeps the heading and button in view while the cards scroll past.

settings.label: Card button opens
settings.info: "Link" goes to the person's link (for example their profile page) instead of opening the side panel.

settings.label: Show the image in the side panel
Desktop layout
settings.info: "Staggered" shows two columns with the left one set lower; phones show a simple stack.

entries.name: Predictive search
entries.description: Predictive search results, fetched by the search drawer through Shopify's predictive search endpoint (routes.predictive_search_url + section_id=predictive-search). Groups: query suggestions (matching part highlighted), products (image, title, optional vendor and price — Theme settings → Search), collections, pages, articles, then a "View all results" link; or a no-results message. Every result is an option for keyboard navigation.
entries.use_when: never add to templates — requested by c-predictive-search.js only.

entries.name: Product card (script)
entries.description: Renders one product card for the product in the URL (/products/<handle>?section_id=product-card-fragment). Never shown on its own: the "Recently viewed" section fetches it through the Section Rendering API, one card per product. The card carries every optional part (spec icons, rating chip, star row); the script removes what the section turned off.
entries.use_when: never add to templates — scripts fetch it by file name.

entries.name: Product comparison
entries.description: Side-by-side comparison of up to 4 products. Rows come from each product's specification metafield (multi-line text, one "Label: Value" per line — the same custom.specifications field the Specifications block reads) and are aligned by label, so every product's value sits in the right row; missing values show "—". "true" / "false" values become check / cross icons. Optional "Highlight differences" switch, product header that sticks while scrolling (desktop), Add to cart per column (with a variant menu for products with options) and a sticky first column when the table scrolls sideways on phones.
entries.use_when: "compare models", "which one is right for me", thickness / size / edition comparisons. Fill the metafield per product in admin; no specs are typed into the theme.

settings.label: Products
settings.info: Up to 4. Rows come from each product's specification metafield.

settings.label: Specification metafield
settings.info: namespace.key of a multi-line text metafield with one "Label: Value" per line. The Specifications block reads the same field.

settings.label: Keep product names visible while scrolling
settings.info: Desktop.

entries.name: Quick view (script)
entries.description: Quick view window content: gallery, vendor, title, price, variant picker, quantity + Add to cart and a "View full details" link, wrapped in a modal <dialog>. Product cards fetch it through the Section Rendering API (/products/<handle>?section_id=product-quick-view) when the shopper presses "+" on a product with options; variant switching and adding to cart reuse the product page components. Full screen on phones, centred window on desktop.
entries.use_when: never add to templates — c-quick-add.js loads it by file name.

entries.name: Product recommendations
entries.description: "You may also like" row on product pages, filled by Shopify's product recommendations (related or complementary products). Loads after the page so it never slows the product view.
entries.use_when: product templates, below the main product section.

settings.label: Show quick add on product cards
settings.info: A "+" button adds single-variant products at once and opens a quick view window for products with options.

settings.label: Show spec icons on product cards
settings.info: Up to 3 icons from the product metafield custom.highlights (list of single line texts, one "icon: text" per line, e.g. "battery: 38 h battery").

settings.label: Show rating on the card image
settings.info: A small "★ 4.5" chip in the corner of the image instead of the star row. Needs Theme settings → Product cards → Show rating and a reviews app.

entries.name: Recently viewed
entries.description: "Recently viewed" row: products this shopper opened on this device, newest first, without the product currently shown. History stays in the shopper's browser (up to 12 products); the section is hidden until there is something to show. Cards load after the page, near the viewport.
entries.use_when: product pages (below recommendations), cart page, search page, 404 page — anywhere a "pick up where you left off" row helps.

settings.label: Show quick add on product cards
settings.info: A "+" button adds single-variant products at once and opens a quick view window for products with options.

settings.label: Show spec icons on product cards
settings.info: Up to 3 icons from the product metafield custom.highlights (list of single line texts, one "icon: text" per line, e.g. "battery: 38 h battery").

settings.label: Show rating on the card image
settings.info: A small "★ 4.5" chip in the corner of the image instead of the star row. Needs Theme settings → Product cards → Show rating and a reviews app.

entries.name: Reveal image with text
entries.description: Scroll-driven reveal: a full-screen image opens from a small centred window to full bleed while the section is pinned, then the text blocks (heading, text, buttons) fade in over it. Pure CSS scroll-driven animations — no JavaScript. Browsers without support, and shoppers who prefer reduced motion, get a normal full-height image banner with the text shown at once. Can make the header transparent when it is the first section on the page (the text moves below the header).
entries.use_when: a statement moment between sections — launch story, brand manifesto, one big product image with a short message.

settings.label: Mobile image
settings.info: Optional. Use a portrait image for phones.

settings.label: Starting window size
settings.info: How much of the image shows before scrolling. Older browsers and reduced motion show the full image at once.

settings.label: Transparent header
settings.info: When this is the first section on the page, the header sits on top of it without a background.

settings.label: Heading highlight
settings.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

settings.label: Text colors
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

settings.label: Color scheme
settings.info: Background around the image while it opens.

entries.name: Rich text
entries.description: Stack of text blocks — headings, paragraphs, buttons, icons, dividers or any other theme block — in a narrow, page-wide or full-width column, aligned start, center or end (separately on mobile).
entries.use_when: page intros ("Contact us", "Frequently asked questions" titles), short brand statements, call-to-action strips, contact details. Text can be connected to page or shop metafields with dynamic sources instead of typing it into several templates.

settings.label: Content alignment on desktop
settings.info: Positions the blocks. Heading and text blocks also have their own text alignment.

entries.name: Scroll reveal text
entries.description: Big statement text whose words (or, for Chinese and other text without spaces, characters) fill from a faint color to full color one after another as the section scrolls up the screen. Pure CSS scroll-driven animation on spans generated in Liquid; screen readers get the sentence once, as plain text. Browsers without scroll-driven animations and shoppers who prefer reduced motion see the text in full color at once.
entries.use_when: a brand statement or manifesto between sections ("We believe…"), an about-page intro, a slow reading moment before a product story.

settings.label: Text
settings.info: Words fill with color one after another as the shopper scrolls. Press Enter for a new line.
settings.default: Every piece we make starts with a sketch, a question and a lot of patience. We keep going until it feels right in your hands.

settings.label: Fill step
settings.info: "Automatic" fills word by word, or character by character for text without spaces (Chinese, Japanese).

settings.label: Starting color strength
settings.info: How visible the text is before it fills. Shoppers who prefer reduced motion see full color.

settings.label: HTML tag
settings.info: For SEO. Does not change the look.

entries.name: Scroll story
entries.description: Sticky scroll story: on large screens a media panel (image or Shopify-hosted video) stays in view beside a column of text steps; as each step reaches the middle of the screen its own image wipes in over the panel and a progress bar marks the step. Steps without an image keep the current picture. Each step is a local block: eyebrow, heading, text, button and optional image. Phones, tablets, shoppers who prefer reduced motion and browsers without JavaScript get a plain stacked layout (each step with its image above the text).
entries.use_when: telling a product or brand story in 2–5 steps (how it's made, key features one by one, setup), usually on product or landing pages.

settings.label: Starting image
settings.info: Shown before the first step image, and as the video cover.

settings.label: Video
settings.info: Plays muted in a loop instead of the starting image (with a pause button).

settings.label: Media height on desktop
settings.info: Never taller than the screen.

entries.name: Scrolling images
entries.description: Endless row of image and text tiles that scrolls sideways (marquee) at a set speed and direction. Optional tilt (the strip is rotated 0–6°) and twin rows (a second, decorative row of the same tiles moving the other way). Pauses on hover and keyboard focus, has a visible pause button, and stops off screen. With reduced motion (or without JavaScript) it is a single static row shoppers can swipe (the tilt stays). Mobile images supported per tile.
entries.use_when: brand moments, press or community photos, "as seen on", a moving strip of product shots or short slogans between sections.

settings.label: Heading highlight
settings.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

settings.label: Speed
settings.info: Pixels per second. Stops on hover, on keyboard focus and with the pause button; static for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Add a second row
settings.info: A second row of the same images moves the other way. Hidden for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

settings.label: Tilt
settings.info: Rotates the strip for a more dynamic look. 0 keeps it straight.

entries.name: Search drawer
entries.description: Search panel opened from the header search icon or the mobile dock (slides in from the side or drops from the top — Theme settings → Search). Shows suggested links while empty and, with predictive search on, live results as you type: query suggestions, products (image, title, optional vendor and price), collections, pages and articles. Arrow keys move through results, Enter opens one, Escape closes; the number of results is announced. Without JavaScript the form goes to the search page.
entries.use_when: never add to templates — the layout renders it when Theme settings → Search → Search type is "Drawer".

entries.name: Shop the feed
entries.description: Social-style wall of posts ("shop the feed"): a grid or swipe row of image or Shopify-hosted video tiles, each with up to 3 tagged products shown as small thumbnails. Clicking a tile opens a window with the large media, the caption, the tagged products (with quick add) and a link to the original post; previous / next buttons and the arrow keys move between posts. Header with heading, account avatar, handle and a "Follow" button. Everything is uploaded by the merchant — no connection to Instagram or TikTok, no external requests. Media load lazily; the windows are real dialogs (focus trap, Escape, focus return).
entries.use_when: bringing social content (Instagram, TikTok, UGC photos) onto the home page or a landing page and making it shoppable. For one large image with hotspots use "lookbook".

settings.label: Heading highlight
settings.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

settings.label: Account name
settings.info: For example @yourstore. Shown next to the Follow button and in every post window.

settings.label: Follow button link
settings.info: Your profile on the social network. Opens in a new tab.

settings.label: Network icon
settings.info: Shown on the tiles, the Follow button and the "View post" link.

settings.label: Icons on tiles
settings.info: Pick a scheme whose text color stands out on your photos.

settings.label: Show quick add on product cards
settings.info: A "+" button adds single-variant products at once and opens a quick view window for products with options.

entries.name: Slideshow
entries.description: Slideshow of 1–6 slides, each with its own image (mobile image optional) or muted video, overlay and blocks (heading, text, buttons). Two layouts: "full" (one slide fills the width) or "peek" (the current slide is inset with rounded corners and a sliver of the previous and next slides shows at the sides; clicking a side slide moves to it). Swipe, arrows, dots and arrow keys; optional autoplay with a visible pause button that stops on hover and focus. Respects reduced motion (no autoplay until the shopper presses play). Can make the header transparent when it is the first section.
entries.use_when: several campaigns or categories share the first screen of the home page; rotating promotional banners. For a single banner use "hero".

settings.label: Change slides automatically
settings.info: A pause button is always shown. Shoppers who prefer reduced motion must press play first.

settings.label: Slideshow description
settings.info: Read by screen readers, e.g. "Current promotions". Leave empty for "Slideshow".

settings.label: Layout
settings.info: "Peek" insets the current slide with rounded corners and shows a sliver of the previous and next slides at the sides.

settings.label: Height
