settings.info: "Adapt to image" uses the first slide's image.

settings.label: Transparent header
settings.info: When this is the first section on the page, the header sits on top of it without a background.

settings.label: Heading highlight
settings.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

settings.label: Color scheme
settings.info: Colors of the slide controls and the space around the slides.

entries.name: Stats
entries.description: Row of big numbers with a label under each ("150K+ orders shipped", "4.8/5 average rating"). Numbers are typed as text; when they scroll into view the digits count up from zero while prefixes, suffixes, decimals and thousands separators stay exactly as typed. Screen readers get the final value; reduced motion shows it at once. Optional heading group, 2–5 columns, plain / bordered / filled cards.
entries.use_when: trust figures, impact numbers, product facts worth highlighting — only numbers you can back up.

settings.label: Count up when shown
settings.info: Runs once. Visitors who prefer reduced motion see the final number.

entries.name: Tech specs
entries.description: Tech specs: a heading and an accordion of spec groups (Sound, Design, Battery, Connectivity…); inside an open group the specs sit in two columns ("Label: value" per line; lines starting with "-" add more values under the item above). Each group reads its lines from a product metafield (multi-line text or list of single line texts, e.g. custom.specs_sound) when the product has one, else from the group's own text — so one template serves every product. Only one group open at a time or several; the first can start open. Optional "In the box" card beside the accordion (sticky on desktop, below on phones) with round pictures and labels, in its own color scheme. Groups without content are hidden.
entries.use_when: product templates (below the main product) for technical products; also usable on landing pages with typed-in specs.

settings.label: Open one group at a time
Keep the card in view while scrolling (desktop)

entries.name: Testimonials
entries.description: Customer quotes as a grid, a slider with previous/next buttons, a "scattered" column of staggered cards under a big two-line heading (first line at the start, second line at the end), or a "banner" showing one quote at a time over a background image with previous/next buttons. Each quote can show a star rating (read out as text, e.g. "4 out of 5 stars"), the author's name, role or city, an avatar and a link to the product it is about. Ships with obvious placeholder text only — never invented reviews — which never reaches the storefront (the section stays hidden until a real quote is entered), and shows a reminder in the theme editor that quotes must be genuine.
entries.use_when: a few hand-picked, real customer or press quotes on the home page, product pages or landing pages. For live review data use a reviews app block instead.

settings.label: Heading, second line
settings.info: Shown on its own line at the end side, under the heading.

settings.label: Text colors
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

entries.name: Timeline
entries.description: Milestones in order — each with a date or label, heading, text and an image or video (Shopify video or YouTube / Vimeo link, loaded only on click). Desktop: a horizontal scrolling row with previous/next buttons and an optional row of date buttons (above or below the row) that jump to each milestone; the next milestone can peek in at the edge. Card style "Image beside text" puts the media next to the text in a tinted card — one wide milestone at a time. Mobile: a vertical line with the milestones stacked.
entries.use_when: brand history ("Our story"), product generations, how an order is made, project or launch roadmaps.

settings.label: Show date buttons
settings.info: Desktop only. Each button jumps to its milestone.

settings.label: Milestone style
settings.info: "Image beside text" works best with one milestone visible on desktop.

settings.label: Show part of the next milestone
settings.info: Desktop only. Hints that the row can be scrolled.

entries.name: Video
entries.description: Video from Shopify, YouTube or Vimeo with a cover image and play button; optional text overlay built from blocks (heading, text, buttons). Autoplay plays muted after the page has loaded, never on data-saver / 2G connections or with reduced motion, always with a pause button. In banner mode (full width) it can make the header transparent when it is the first section on the page.
entries.use_when: installation or brand videos, product demos, a video banner with a headline on top.

settings.label: Shopify video
settings.info: Upload in Content → Files. Used instead of the video link.

settings.label: YouTube or Vimeo link
settings.info: Used when no Shopify video is chosen. Embedded without tracking cookies where possible.

settings.label: Cover image
settings.info: Shown until the video plays. Shopify videos use their own preview image when empty.

settings.label: Video description
settings.info: Tells screen reader users what the video shows.

settings.label: Autoplay (muted)
settings.info: Plays muted after the page has loaded. Never on data-saver or slow connections, or for shoppers who prefer reduced motion. A pause button is always shown.

settings.label: Transparent header
settings.info: Banner mode (full width) only. When this is the first section on the page, the header sits on top of the video without a background.

settings.label: Heading highlight
settings.info: Select words in the heading and press the italic (I) button to highlight them.

settings.label: Text colors
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

entries.name: Announcement
entries.description: One message in the announcement bar: short text (bold/italic/links allowed), optional shorter text for phones, optional link for the whole message and an optional icon from the theme icon set.
entries.use_when: only inside the announcement-bar section.

settings.label: Text on mobile
settings.info: Optional shorter text for small screens.

settings.label: Icon
settings.info: Hidden on small screens.

entries.name: Collage tile
entries.description: One tile of a Collage section: an image, a video, a product (image, title, price) or a collection (image, title). Spans 1–12 of the 12 desktop columns and 1–4 rows; full or half width on mobile. Image, product and collection tiles are fully clickable and named after their title (or the link label). The text over the tile can add a subtitle line under the title and an arrow at the end.
entries.use_when: only inside the "collage" section.

settings.label: Autoplay (muted)
settings.info: Plays muted while visible, with a pause button. Otherwise shoppers press play.

settings.label: Image
settings.info: Video cover, or replaces the product / collection image.

settings.label: Title
settings.info: Leave empty to use the product or collection title.

settings.label: Subtitle
settings.info: A short line under the title.

settings.label: Link description
settings.info: Read by screen readers when the tile has no title.

settings.label: Width (columns)
settings.info: Out of 12 columns on desktop. 6 = half, 4 = a third.

entries.name: Column
entries.description: One column in a Multicolumn section: an image, an icon (built-in set or uploaded SVG/PNG) or no media, then a heading, rich text and an optional link. Card look, alignment, icon size / position and image ratio come from the section.
entries.use_when: only inside the "multicolumn" section.

settings.label: Custom icon
settings.info: Replaces the built-in icon. Square SVG or PNG.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Pair a short heading with one or two lines about a feature, a promise or a step.

settings.label: Link
settings.info: The heading and image link here. Add a link label to also show a text link.

entries.name: Dock item
entries.description: One entry in the mobile dock: icon above a short label. Actions: home, menu (opens the header menu drawer; hidden when the header has no menu), search (opens the search drawer, or the search page), cart (live item count; opens the cart drawer, or the cart page), account (only when customer accounts are on) or a custom link with an icon of your choice. Without JavaScript every entry is a normal link.
entries.use_when: only inside the mobile-dock section.

entries.name: Feature
entries.description: One selling point in a Features section: icon (from the theme's icon set or an uploaded image), short title and one line of text.
entries.use_when: only inside the "features" section.

settings.label: Custom icon
settings.info: Replaces the built-in icon. Square SVG or PNG.

entries.name: Form field
entries.description: Extra question in a Contact form section: short text, long text, checkbox, radio buttons or dropdown, optionally required and full width. With the section's "labels inside fields" option the label is read by screen readers and shown as the placeholder. Radio buttons are grouped under a legend so screen readers read the question with each option. The answer arrives in the contact email under the "Name in email" (or the label when that is empty).
entries.use_when: only inside the "contact-form" section, e.g. order number, topic dropdown, "I'm a business customer" checkbox.

settings.label: Name in email
settings.info: Optional. Keeps answers under the same name in your inbox when you reword the label.

settings.label: Options
settings.info: Separate options with commas.

entries.name: Image card
entries.description: One card in an Image cards section: image with title, optional text and link label over a dark gradient at the bottom. The whole card is the link.
entries.use_when: only inside the "image-cards" section.

settings.label: Image
settings.info: Leave empty to use the collection image.

settings.label: Title
settings.info: Leave empty to use the collection title.

settings.label: Link
settings.info: Leave empty to link to the collection.

entries.name: Logo
entries.description: One logo in a Logo list section: image shown at the section's logo height (width follows the image, capped so wide logos stay balanced), a brand name used as alt text and link name, and an optional link (same or new tab). Without an image the brand name is shown as a simple text wordmark at the logo height; with neither, a placeholder logo.
entries.use_when: only inside the "logo-list" section.

settings.label: Logo image
settings.info: SVG or PNG with a transparent background works best.

settings.label: Brand name
settings.info: Used as alt text and link name for screen readers.

entries.name: Phrase
entries.description: One phrase in a Marquee section, optionally a link, followed by the section's separator (dot, slash, star or none). No separator is added when the phrase already ends with one of its own (/ | • · * ✦ — -), so a strip never shows two in a row. Outline text follows the section setting.
entries.use_when: only inside the "marquee" section.

entries.name: Icon row
entries.description: One row of an icon list: a built-in icon (or an uploaded one) followed by a short text that may contain bold, italic and links. Icon size comes from the parent block (--icon-size).
entries.use_when: inside product-icon-list (highlights) or product-trust (shipping / returns / warranty rows). Not placed on its own.

settings.label: Custom icon
settings.info: Replaces the built-in icon. Square SVG or PNG.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Add a short benefit or promise

entries.name: Registration field
entries.description: One extra field on the create-account form: short text, long text, checkbox, radio buttons or dropdown. The answer is saved in the customer's note as "Label: value". A checkbox sends its value only when ticked.
entries.use_when: only inside the "main-register" section, to ask new customers for more details (company, birthday month, how they heard about you).

settings.label: Label
settings.info: Shown to customers and used as the name of the answer in the customer note.

settings.label: Value when ticked
settings.info: Saved in the customer note when the box is ticked. Nothing is saved when it is not.

settings.label: Choices
settings.info: Separate choices with commas, e.g. Friend, Search, Social media.

entries.name: Scrolling tile
entries.description: One tile in a Scrolling images row: an image (separate mobile image optional) with an optional caption, or — when no image is chosen — a large text tile. Optional link; the tile's accessible name is its caption, the image alt text or the link label.
entries.use_when: only inside the "scrolling-images" section.

settings.label: Mobile image
settings.info: Optional. Shown on phones instead of the image.

settings.label: Caption
settings.info: Shown under the image. Without an image the tile shows this text large.

settings.label: Link description
settings.info: Read by screen readers when the tile has no title.

entries.name: Slide
entries.description: One slide of a Slideshow section: background image (separate mobile image optional) or muted looping Shopify video, darkening overlay, and any blocks (heading, text, buttons) placed in one of nine positions. An optional slide link makes the whole slide clickable; its accessible name is the link label, or the slide heading. When the section height is "Adapt to image", the first slide sets the slideshow ratio from its own image. In the section's "peek" layout the slide is inset with rounded corners (styled by the section); with the section's transparent header the content moves below the header.
entries.use_when: only inside the "slideshow" section.

settings.label: Mobile image
settings.info: Optional. Use a portrait image for phones.

settings.label: Background video
settings.info: Shopify video, plays muted on loop while the slide is shown. Replaces the image.

settings.label: Text colors
settings.info: Pick the surface whose text reads best on your image.

settings.label: Link for the whole slide
settings.info: Makes the entire slide clickable. Leave empty if the slide has buttons.

settings.label: Link description
settings.info: Read by screen readers. Leave empty to use the slide heading.

entries.name: Spec tile
entries.description: One spec tile inside "Spec highlight tiles": an icon, a value ("38h") and a short label ("Battery life"). Follows the parent's tile style (bordered, filled or plain). Hidden when value and label are both empty.
entries.use_when: child of the product-spec-tiles block (blocks source).

settings.label: Value
settings.info: Short, e.g. 40mm or 38h.

entries.name: Stat
entries.description: One figure in a Stats section: the number exactly as it should read ("150K+", "$2.5M", "4.8/5", "98%"), a label and an optional note. When the section animates, the digits count up once on first view (assets/c-counter.js); screen readers always get the final text. Blocks with an empty number are skipped.
entries.use_when: only inside the "stats" section, and only for figures you can verify.

settings.label: Number
settings.info: Type it exactly as it should read, e.g. 150K+, $2.5M, 4.8/5, 98%.

entries.name: Testimonial
entries.description: One customer quote in a Testimonials section: the quote, optional star rating (accessible text, no star characters read aloud), author name, role or city, avatar and a link to the product it is about. Blocks with an empty quote, or the untouched placeholder quote, are skipped on the storefront; a real quote carries data-testimonial, which the section uses to stay hidden until one exists. Rating defaults to none — only add one the customer actually gave.
entries.use_when: only inside the "testimonials" section, and only with genuine quotes you have permission to publish.

settings.label: Quote
settings.info: Use the customer's own words.

settings.label: Role or location
settings.info: For example a city. Write "Verified buyer" only when you checked the order.

settings.label: Star rating
settings.info: Only the rating this customer actually gave.

entries.name: Button
entries.description: Call-to-action link styled as a button (primary, secondary or text link). Renders a disabled button when no link is set so layouts stay visible in the editor.
entries.use_when: any clickable CTA such as "Shop now" or "Learn more".

entries.name: Collapsible row
entries.description: Expandable row with a title that reveals any blocks inside it (text, product description, specifications, images). Rows stack into an accordion.
entries.use_when: FAQs, product details such as specs / shipping / care, long content that should stay out of the way.

entries.name: Contact detail
entries.description: One piece of contact information: a small uppercase label ("Address", "Email", "Opening hours") over rich text (links, line breaks), with an optional icon and optionally the store's social media icons (Theme settings → Social media). Inside a Contact form section it moves into the details column or the row of cards below the form and follows that section's detail style (plain, tinted box or bordered cards).
entries.use_when: address, email, phone, opening hours, "Follow us" on contact pages, in the Map section's info card, or in any Container / Group.

settings.label: Text
settings.info: Address, email or phone links, opening hours. Use line breaks for several lines.

settings.label: Show social media icons
settings.info: Links from Theme settings → Social media.

entries.name: Countdown
entries.description: Countdown timer to a real deadline (date YYYY-MM-DD + time HH:MM in the store's time zone), standard (numbers over unit labels) or compact (one line). Invalid or missing dates show no timer; after the deadline it shows an optional "ended" message or disappears. Screen readers get the end date once instead of a ticking announcement.
entries.use_when: a real sale or launch deadline inside any section that accepts theme blocks (container, rich text, group, hero). Never for fake urgency.

settings.label: End date
settings.info: Format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-12-31. An invalid date shows no timer.

settings.label: End time
settings.info: 24-hour format HH:MM, e.g. 18:00. Leave empty for midnight.

entries.name: Divider
entries.description: Thin line that separates content. Horizontal, or vertical for use between items in a horizontal group (on mobile, where rows usually stack, a vertical divider turns horizontal). Thickness, length, solid / dashed / dotted style and space around it are settings; the color follows the color scheme's border color. Hidden from screen readers (decorative).
entries.use_when: separating groups of blocks, between a heading and a list, or as a vertical rule between items in a row.

settings.label: Direction
settings.info: Vertical is for horizontal groups; it turns horizontal on mobile.

entries.name: Email signup
entries.description: Newsletter sign-up form as a block: optional heading and text, an email field that adds the shopper to Shopify customers with marketing consent (tagged "newsletter"), a text or arrow button, and an optional consent / privacy line under the field (e.g. a link to the privacy policy). Shows a thank-you message or the error under this form only after submitting.
entries.use_when: footer columns, inside groups on landing pages, anywhere a compact sign-up is needed (use the newsletter section for a full-width band).

settings.label: Consent or privacy line
settings.info: Shown under the field, e.g. a link to your privacy policy.

entries.name: Group
entries.description: Nested layout box that holds other blocks in a row or column, with its own optional color scheme, padding and optional card styling. Groups can contain groups.
entries.use_when: arranging existing blocks side by side inside a section (e.g. image next to heading + text + button), simple cards or columns. Repeating items with their own icon/text settings that operators edit often (badges, feature lists) are better as a custom block with child blocks.

entries.name: Heading
entries.description: Heading text with a semantic tag (H1–H6) and a size preset. Size and tag are independent so SEO structure never dictates looks.
entries.use_when: titles and section headings. For paragraphs use the "text" block.

settings.label: HTML tag
settings.info: For SEO. Does not change the look.

entries.name: Icon
entries.description: One icon from the theme's built-in line-icon set (follows the text color) or an uploaded SVG/PNG, at a chosen size, optionally linked. A text label names the link (or the image) for screen readers; without a link and label the icon is decorative.
entries.use_when: a small visual cue next to text in any section that accepts theme blocks — trust badges in a group, an icon above a heading, a linked social or contact icon.

settings.label: Custom icon
settings.info: Replaces the built-in icon. Square SVG or PNG.

settings.label: Accessible label
settings.info: Read by screen readers. Needed when the icon is a link or carries meaning on its own.

entries.name: Image
entries.description: Responsive image with aspect ratio, optional rounded corners and optional link. Uses the focal point set in Shopify admin. Shows a placeholder until an image is chosen.
entries.use_when: single images in any layout. For image + text side by side, put an image block and a group block inside a row container.

entries.name: Custom Liquid
entries.description: Merchant-entered Liquid/HTML code snippet. Classes used here only work if they are in CLASS_VOCAB.md, because this content is never scanned by the CSS build.
entries.use_when: a one-off embed (third-party widget code, simple HTML). Prefer a real custom block for anything reused or styled.

settings.label: Liquid code
settings.info: Only classes listed in CLASS_VOCAB.md are styled here.

entries.name: Country and language
entries.description: Country / currency and language selectors for Shopify Markets (renders the localization-form snippet). Each selector only appears when the store offers more than one option. Changes apply immediately.
entries.use_when: footer or header, once the store sells in several countries or languages (Settings → Markets, Languages).

entries.name: Logo
entries.description: The store logo from Theme settings → Logo (normal or light/inverse version, for dark backgrounds) linking to the home page, with its own width. Falls back to the store name as text when no logo is uploaded.
entries.use_when: footer brand column, landing-page headers, "about us" blocks.

entries.name: Map
entries.description: Map of one address from Google Maps (no API key needed), tinted standard, grey, muted or dark, at a set height (separate mobile height). Optional "load on click" shows a fallback image with a "Show map" button so nothing is loaded from Google before the visitor asks; optional "Open in Google Maps" link. Without an address it shows the fallback image.
entries.use_when: a store location inside a Container, Group or Image with text — "Visit our showroom", contact pages, event venues. For a full-width map with an info card use the Map section.

settings.label: Address
settings.info: Street address or place name as you would type it into Google Maps. No API key needed.

settings.label: Fallback image
settings.info: Shown when no address is set, and as the preview when the map loads on click.

settings.label: Load map on click
settings.info: Shows the fallback image with a "Show map" button; nothing is loaded from Google until the visitor presses it. Useful where cookie consent is required.

entries.name: Menu
entries.description: Heading and a vertical list of links from a store menu (Online Store → Navigation). Only the first level is shown. On phones the column can fold into an accordion under its heading (closed or open by default); from 750px up the list is always shown.
entries.use_when: footer link columns ("Shop", "Help"), sidebars, sitemap-style lists.

settings.label: Collapse on mobile
settings.info: Needs a heading. From 750px up the links are always shown.

entries.name: agentsws credit
entries.description: "Built with agentsws" credit link for the footer. OPEN-SOURCE EDITION ONLY: files prefixed oss- are removed from any Theme Store package (Theme Store forbids designer credits). Never render oss- files from other Liquid files; only place them via JSON templates or section groups.
entries.use_when: footer group of the open-source edition.

entries.name: Add-ons
entries.description: "Frequently bought together" / add-ons: up to 4 hand-picked products, each with a checkbox and (for products with options) a variant menu, optionally led by the product on the page in its selected variant. A live total and one "Add selected" button put every ticked item in the cart in a single request, then open the cart drawer. Sold-out items cannot be ticked. Hidden when no add-on products are chosen. Prices are shown as they are — no invented bundle discount. Style "Collapsible card" puts the list in a tinted card whose heading row (with an optional icon, e.g. "Popular upgrades") opens and closes it.
entries.use_when: accessories, refills, warranties or "complete the set" offers on the product page. Real bundle discounts come from Shopify discounts (they apply at checkout).

settings.label: Add-on products
settings.info: Up to 4. Shoppers tick the ones they want and add them together.

settings.label: Include this product
settings.info: Lists the product on the page first, in the selected variant.

entries.name: Badges
entries.description: Badges for the selected variant, styled like the product card badges: sale ("Save 20%" / "Save $10" / "Sale"), "Sold out", automatic "New" for recently published products and the merchant's own labels from the product metafield custom.label (single line text, or a list for several labels). Updates when the variant changes; hidden when there is nothing to show.
entries.use_when: product info column, above or next to the title ("show a sale badge", "add a label like Bestseller or Limited edition").

settings.label: "New" badge for products published within
settings.info: 0 = off.

settings.label: Show custom labels
settings.info: From the product metafield custom.label (single line text, or a list for several labels).

entries.name: Buy buttons
entries.description: Quantity selector, Add to cart button and accelerated checkout buttons (Shop Pay, Apple Pay…) for the selected variant. Adds without leaving the page and opens the cart drawer when Theme settings → Cart uses the drawer. Optionally shows the selected variant's price inside the button ("Add to cart · $99.00"), updated when the variant changes.
entries.use_when: product info column; any section that has a product.

settings.label: Show price in the Add to cart button
settings.info: For example "Add to cart · $99.00". Follows the selected variant.

settings.label: Show accelerated checkout buttons
settings.info: Shop Pay, Apple Pay and other wallets set up in Settings → Payments.

entries.name: Complementary products
entries.description: "Pairs well with" list: Shopify's complementary product recommendations for this product as compact rows (image, title, price) with a quick add button — single-variant products are added at once, others open the quick view. Loads after the page when scrolled near; stays hidden when Shopify has no complementary products.
entries.use_when: product info column, to suggest accessories or add-ons. Set the pairs in the Shopify Search & Discovery app → Product recommendations → Complementary products.

settings.label: Show quick add on product cards
settings.info: A "+" button adds single-variant products at once and opens a quick view window for products with options.

entries.name: Countdown
entries.description: Countdown (days, hours, minutes, seconds) to a real end date stored on the product — a date and time metafield, custom.sale_ends by default. Shows nothing when the product has no date or the date has passed, and hides itself the moment it reaches zero. Never invents a deadline.
entries.use_when: product info column, for a genuine limited-time offer ("sale ends in", "pre-order closes in"). Create the metafield (type "Date and time") in Settings → Custom data → Products and fill it per product.

settings.label: End date metafield
settings.info: namespace.key of a product "Date and time" metafield. Hidden when empty or in the past.

entries.name: Product description
entries.description: The product description written in Shopify admin, as rich text.
entries.use_when: product info column, on its own or inside a collapsible row.

entries.name: Highlights
entries.description: Product highlights: a short list of icon + text lines ("Waterproof to 30 m", "2-year warranty"). Either add up to 6 rows as child blocks, or read them per product from a metafield — list of single line texts (custom.highlights by default), one line per item written "icon: text", e.g. "truck: Ships in 24 hours". Icon names: check, truck, return, shield, lock, chat, star, globe, gift, leaf, clock, pin, ruler, info, bolt, battery, water, headphones; lines without a known icon get a check mark. Hidden when empty. On the main product page the list can sit below the images on desktop (Placement).
entries.use_when: key selling points next to the buy buttons; product-specific highlights maintained in admin (metafield mode).

settings.label: Metafield
settings.info: namespace.key of a list of single line text, one "icon: text" per entry, e.g. "truck: Ships in 24 hours".

settings.label: Placement
settings.info: "Below the images" works in the main product section on desktop; on phones the block follows the product info.

entries.name: Stock status
entries.description: Stock status of the selected variant, read from Shopify's real inventory: "In stock", "Only 3 left" with a small bar under the low-stock threshold, "Out of stock", "Available to order" when overselling is allowed, and optionally the next incoming stock date. Shows nothing for variants whose inventory Shopify does not track. Updates when the variant changes.
entries.use_when: product info column, near the buy buttons ("show stock", "low stock message", "only X left").

settings.label: Low stock threshold
settings.info: At or below this quantity, show "Only N left". 0 = always show "In stock".

settings.label: Show incoming stock date
settings.info: When the variant is out of stock and a transfer with a date is on its way.

entries.name: Pickup availability
entries.description: Local pickup availability of the selected variant: "Pickup available at <store>" with the usual preparation time (or "not available"), and a link that opens a side panel listing every pickup location with status, address and phone. Uses Shopify's own store availability data; hidden when no location offers pickup or the variant is sold out. Updates when the variant changes.
entries.use_when: stores with local pickup enabled (Settings → Shipping and delivery → Local pickup).

entries.name: Pop-up link
entries.description: A link or button ("Size guide", "Shipping information", "Need help?") that opens a side panel with the content of a store page. The panel traps focus, closes with Esc, the close button or a click outside, and returns focus to the link. Hidden until a page is chosen.
entries.use_when: size charts, delivery / returns details, care instructions or help text that should not crowd the product page. Edit the text in Online Store → Pages.

settings.label: Page
settings.info: Its title and content show in a side panel. Edit it in Online Store → Pages.

settings.label: Link text
settings.info: Empty = the page title.

entries.name: Price
entries.description: Selected variant's price with compare-at price and unit price, plus the store's tax / shipping note. Updates when the variant changes.
entries.use_when: product info column; any section that has a product.

entries.name: Rating
entries.description: Star rating with score and review count from the standard Shopify review metafields (reviews.rating, reviews.rating_count) that review apps fill. Links to the reviews on the page (an element with the anchor id, "reviews" by default). Hidden when the product has no reviews — never shows invented ratings.
entries.use_when: product info column, usually under the title. Needs a reviews app that writes the standard metafields.

settings.label: Link to reviews anchor
settings.info: Id of the reviews element on the page, without #. Leave empty for no link.

entries.name: Share row
entries.description: Share row: "Share:" followed by round icon links for the networks switched on in Theme settings → Social media → Share buttons (Facebook, X, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Telegram, email) plus "Copy link" (confirmed with a status message) and, where the device supports it, a native "Share" button. Links open in a new tab and say so to screen readers. At the other end of the row an optional "Need help?" link to a page, and/or Pop-up link child blocks that open a store page in a side panel (size guide, help, shipping).
entries.use_when: bottom of the product info column (or article pages) — a compact share + help line instead of the Share dropdown button.

settings.label: Show device share button
settings.info: Opens the phone's or computer's own share menu where the browser supports it.

entries.name: SKU
entries.description: SKU (stock keeping unit) of the selected variant, e.g. "SKU: TS-BLK-M". Updates when the variant changes; hidden while the variant has no SKU.
entries.use_when: product info column, for stores whose shoppers quote part numbers (spare parts, B2B, electronics).

entries.name: Spec tiles
entries.description: Spec highlight tiles: small tiles of icon + value + label ("40mm / Driver size", "38h / Battery life"), optionally inside a card with a heading ("Product highlights"). Rows come from child tiles or, per product, from a metafield — a list of single line texts or a multi-line text, one tile per line written "value|label|icon", e.g. "38h|Battery life|battery" (icon optional: battery, bluetooth, bolt, headphones, speaker, mic, waves, weight, plug, ruler, clock, water, shield, leaf, star, box, globe, check). Tile style bordered, filled or plain; columns fit the content or form an even grid. On the main product page the block can sit below the images on desktop (Placement). Hidden when empty.
entries.use_when: key numbers of a technical product (driver size, weight, battery, connectivity) under the gallery or in the info column; product-specific values maintained in admin (metafield mode).

settings.label: Metafield
settings.info: namespace.key of a list of single line texts or a multi-line text, one tile per line "value|label|icon", e.g. "38h|Battery life|battery". Icons: battery, bluetooth, bolt, headphones, speaker, mic, waves, weight, plug, ruler, clock, water, shield, leaf, star, box, globe, check.

settings.label: Placement
settings.info: "Below the images" works in the main product section on desktop; on phones the block follows the product info.

entries.name: Specifications
entries.description: Specification table read from a product metafield (multi-line text, one "Label: Value" per line — e.g. "Battery capacity: 250mAh"). Lines without a colon span the full row. Merchants edit specs per product in admin, no code needed.
entries.use_when: technical specifications, dimensions, materials, "what's in the box". Often placed inside a collapsible row.

settings.label: Metafield key
settings.info: Multi-line text metafield, one "Label: Value" per line.

entries.name: Product title
entries.description: Product name as the page heading (h1 on product pages, h2 elsewhere, e.g. in a featured product section), with an optional vendor (brand) line above it that links to all of that vendor's products. Optionally shows the selected variant's price on the same line (title start, price end; stacked on narrow columns), updated when the variant changes — use it instead of a separate Price block.
entries.use_when: product info column; any section that has a product (featured product).

settings.label: Show price next to the title
settings.info: Use instead of a separate Price block. Follows the selected variant.

entries.name: Trust rows
entries.description: Reassurance rows — icon + one line of text each (delivery promise, returns, warranty, secure checkout), grouped into one panel: a soft card with divider lines, or plain rows. Each row is a child block; text can include bold and links (e.g. to the returns policy).
entries.use_when: under the buy buttons, to answer "when will it arrive / can I return it" before the shopper asks. Keep promises true to the store's policies.

entries.name: Variant picker
entries.description: Option selectors for a product with variants (e.g. Color, Size). Colour options (swatches set in admin, or option names listed in Theme settings → Color swatches) show colour chips, others show buttons or a dropdown. Optionally chosen options (e.g. Color) show each value as a small picture of its variant's image instead. Chips and pictures show the value's name in a tooltip on hover / keyboard focus (optionally with an enlarged picture), a ring when selected, and a strike-through with a faded red ring when sold out. Unavailable combinations are struck through but still selectable so shoppers see them as sold out. Hidden for single-variant products.
entries.use_when: product info column. Needs a section that switches variants (main product).

settings.label: Show colour options as swatches
settings.info: Colour options show colour chips: options whose values have swatches in Shopify admin, and options named in Theme settings → Color swatches. Chip colour: admin swatch, then Theme settings colour names, then the value's name.

settings.label: Show variant images as swatches
settings.info: Each value shows the image of its variant (set variant images in admin). Values without an image show a colour chip (colour options) or a button.

settings.label: Options with image swatches
settings.info: Option names separated by commas. Leave empty to use the first option.

entries.name: Product vendor
entries.description: The product's vendor (brand) as a small line, optionally linking to the list of all products from that vendor. Screen readers hear "Vendor:" before the name. Hidden when the product has no vendor.
entries.use_when: brand line above the product title (product info column, featured product, quick view) when the title block's own vendor line is not wanted, or when the vendor must sit elsewhere in the column.

entries.name: Share
entries.description: "Share" button for the current page (product, article, collection…). Opens the device's own share sheet when the browser supports it; otherwise (and without JavaScript) a small panel lists the channels switched on in Theme settings → Social media → Share buttons (Facebook, X, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Telegram, email) plus "Copy link", which confirms with a status message.
entries.use_when: product info column, blog articles, gift or wish-list pages — anywhere shoppers may want to send the page to someone.

entries.name: Social links
entries.description: Row of social media icons linking to the accounts filled in under Theme settings → Social media (12 networks). Optional small heading. Shows a hint in the theme editor while no account is set; shows nothing to shoppers.
entries.use_when: footer ("Follow us"), contact pages, about sections, anywhere a follow row is needed.

entries.name: Spacer
entries.description: Empty vertical space with separate mobile and desktop heights.
entries.use_when: extra breathing room between blocks that gap/padding settings cannot give.

entries.name: Text
entries.description: Rich text paragraph(s) with size and alignment.
entries.use_when: body copy, descriptions, short notes. For titles use the "heading" block.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Share details about your brand, a product, or a promotion.

entries.name: Video
entries.description: Inline video: a Shopify-hosted video with native controls (optionally muted autoplay + loop, paused when off screen and for reduced motion) or a YouTube / Vimeo link that shows a cover image and play button and only loads the player when clicked. Fixed aspect ratio, so the page does not jump. A description names the video for screen readers.
entries.use_when: a product demo, how-to or brand film inside any section that accepts theme blocks (container, rich text, group, collapsible rows).

settings.label: YouTube or Vimeo link
settings.info: Used when no Shopify-hosted video is selected. The player loads only after a click.

settings.label: Cover image
settings.info: For YouTube / Vimeo links. Without one, a plain panel with the video description shows.

settings.label: Video description
settings.info: Names the video and its play button for screen readers.

settings.label: Autoplay muted
settings.info: Shopify-hosted video only. Plays while on screen; never for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

entries.description: Labeled form field (label above the input) using the theme's input style: text, email, tel, password (with a show / hide button) or multi-line text. Shows the field's error under it and links it with aria-describedby; marks required fields for screen readers and sighted users.
entries.use_when: customer account forms, address forms, comment forms and other Shopify forms.

params.name: name
params.description: The input name, e.g. "customer[email]"

params.name: id
params.description: Unique element id

params.name: label
params.description: Visible label text (already translated)

params.name: type
params.description: text (default), email, tel, password or textarea

params.name: value
params.description: Current value (re-filled after a failed submit)

params.name: autocomplete
params.description: The autocomplete token, e.g. "email", "new-password"

params.name: required
params.description: Field must be filled in

params.name: error
params.description: Error message for this field; marks the input invalid

params.name: invalid
params.description: Mark the input invalid without its own message (the message is elsewhere)

params.name: describedby
params.description: Id of an element that describes the field, e.g. the form's error box

params.name: hint
params.description: Help text under the field

params.name: autocapitalize
params.description: The autocapitalize attribute, e.g. "characters" for postcodes

params.name: inputmode
params.description: The inputmode attribute

entries.description: Fields of a customer address form: name, company, phone, address lines, city, country / region and province (the province list follows the chosen country through <aw-account-addresses>), postal code and "Set as default". Values and errors come from the surrounding customer_address form.
entries.use_when: inside {% form 'customer_address' %} on the addresses page.

params.name: form
params.description: The customer_address form object

params.name: prefix
params.description: Unique id prefix for this form's fields, e.g. "AddressNew" or "AddressEdit-123"

params.name: is_default
params.description: Tick "Set as default address" (the address being edited is the default)

entries.example: {% render 'address-form-fields', form: form, prefix: 'AddressNew' %}

entries.description: Blog post tile: cover image, tag pills, meta line (date / author / reading time / comments), title link and excerpt. Five shapes: stacked (image above text), horizontal (image beside text from tablet up), side (image beside text only on large screens, stacked below that — for narrow columns such as the right side of a collage), lead (large first post, image beside text) and overlay (text on the image over a dark gradient, whole card clickable; fills the height its parent gives it, at least --overlay-min-h, default 24rem). The title is the only focusable link; the image link is hidden from keyboard and screen readers to avoid a duplicate stop. Posts without a cover image show text only.
entries.use_when: blog listing, "latest posts" rows and related posts.

params.name: article
params.description: The article

params.name: blog_url
params.description: URL of the article's blog (tag pills link to its tag pages)

params.name: layout
params.description: stacked (default), horizontal, side, lead or overlay

params.name: overlay_scheme
params.description: Color scheme id for the text of the overlay shape (e.g. a dark scheme with light text); darkens the image with the --overlay-opacity CSS variable set by the parent (default 0.6)

params.name: ratio
params.description: Image shape: natural, square, portrait, landscape (default) or wide

params.name: show_image
params.description: Show the cover image, default true

params.name: show_tags
params.description: Show tag pills

params.name: tags_on_image
params.description: Place the tag pills over the top corner of the cover image instead of above the text (posts without an image keep them above the text)

params.name: meta_icons
params.description: Small calendar / clock icons in the meta line

params.name: show_date
params.description: Show the publish date

params.name: show_author
params.description: Show the author

params.name: show_comments
params.description: Show the comment count (pass true only when the blog has comments enabled)

params.name: show_reading_time
params.description: Show the reading time

params.name: show_excerpt
params.description: Show the excerpt (or the first words of the post when it has no excerpt)

params.name: heading_tag
params.description: Tag for the title, default "h3"

params.name: sizes
params.description: Image sizes attribute, default "(min-width: 990px) 33vw, (min-width: 750px) 50vw, 100vw"

params.name: eager
params.description: Load the image eagerly (first posts above the fold)

entries.description: One line of article facts separated by thin dividers: publish date, author, estimated reading time and comment count (links to the comments). Items that are switched off or empty are skipped; nothing is output when all are off.
entries.use_when: article cards, the article page header and previous / next links.

params.name: article
params.description: The article

params.name: show_date
params.description: Show the publish date

params.name: show_author
params.description: Show "By <author>"

params.name: show_comments
params.description: Show the comment count; pass true only when the blog has comments enabled

params.name: show_reading_time
params.description: Show an estimated reading time (about 220 words per minute)

params.name: class
params.description: Text size and colour classes, default "type-sm text-muted"

params.name: icons
params.description: Put a small calendar icon before the date and a clock icon before the reading time (the comment count always has its speech-bubble icon)

entries.example: {% render 'article-meta', article: article, show_date: true, show_author: true %}

entries.description: Simple row of share links (Facebook, X, Pinterest, WhatsApp, email) for one page. Which networks appear follows Theme settings → Social media → Sharing. Links open in a new tab and say so to screen readers. Outputs nothing when every network is switched off.
entries.use_when: fallback share row on the article page when no Share block is placed there.

params.name: url
params.description: Absolute URL to share

params.name: title
params.description: Title to share

params.name: image
params.description: Image for Pinterest

params.name: style
params.description: "pills" (default, network names in outlined pills) or "icons" (round icon buttons after a "Share:" label)

params.name: trailing
params.description: Rendered HTML shown at the other end of the row (e.g. a comment count link); the row is output even when no network is on

entries.example: {% render 'article-share', url: share_url, title: article.title, image: article.image %}

entries.description: Article tags as small pill links to "this blog, filtered by tag". When the article has a color metafield custom.tag_color, the pills use that color with automatically chosen readable text; otherwise the theme's neutral pill style.
entries.use_when: article cards and the article page header.

params.name: article
params.description: The article

params.name: blog_url
params.description: URL of the article's blog; without it the tags are plain text

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum tags to show, default 3

params.name: on_image
params.description: The pills sit on a photo: use a solid background (page colour) instead of the translucent tint when the article has no tag colour

entries.example: {% render 'article-tags', article: article, blog_url: blog.url %}

entries.description: Product badges as small pills: "Sold out", sale ("Save 20%" / "Save $10" / "Sale"), automatic "New" for recently published products, and the merchant's own labels from the product metafield custom.label (single line text, or a list of single line texts for several labels). Prints only the pills, no wrapper — capture it and skip the wrapper when the result is blank.
entries.use_when: product cards (media corner) and the product page badges block. Defaults follow Theme settings → Product cards → Badges.

params.name: product
params.description: The product

params.name: variant
params.description: Base sale / sold out on this variant instead of the whole product (product page)

params.name: sale_style
params.description: 'percent', 'amount', 'text' or 'none'; default Theme settings → Sale badge

params.name: show_sold_out
params.description: Default Theme settings → Show "Sold out" badge

params.name: new_days
params.description: "New" for products published within this many days (0 = off); default Theme settings

params.name: show_label

Arrow buttons appear when the pointer is over the gallery or they have keyboard focus; thumbnail strips fade at the edge that has more to scroll. Image shape: match the first image, each image's own shape, square, portrait, landscape or wide. Zoom: full-screen viewer (click / tap / Enter, drag to pan, pinch or mouse wheel, arrow keys, Esc) or a 2× magnifier that follows the mouse (touch screens and keyboard open the full-screen viewer); optional magnifier button on phones. Handles images, videos (optional muted autoplay and loop), YouTube/Vimeo and 3D models. Starts on the selected variant's image and can show only the selected variant's images. Variant images: with filter_variant_media, images attached to another variant are hidden, and images can be grouped by option value with a tag in their alt text — at the end ("Side view #color:black", several values "#color:black,blue", several options "#color:black,size:large") or, as before, at the start ("#Color:Black | Side view"). Tagged images show only while a listed value is selected; untagged images always show. The tag is never read out to screen readers.

entries.description: Colour chip for a product option value or a colour filter value. Where the colour or picture comes from, first match wins: 1. an image passed in (variant image swatches); 2. the swatch set in Shopify admin for the option value (Products → option value → swatch colour or image); 3. Theme settings → Color swatches → "Color names": lines "Name: #hex", "Name: file-name.png" (a picture uploaded in Content → Files) or "Name: https://…" (full image link); 4. the value's name as a CSS colour ("Black", "Navy Blue" → navyblue), else its last word ("Matte Black" → black). Values none of these resolve show a neutral chip with the value's first letter. The shape follows Theme settings → Layout → Swatch shape. Decorative (aria-hidden): the caller names the value for screen readers.
entries.use_when: colour options in the variant picker, colour previews on product cards and filters.
